## Type of change

- [ ] `fix:` bug fix
- [ ] `feat:` new feature
- [ ] `feat!:` / breaking change (schema, config shape, or Web App routing)
- [ ] `docs:` documentation only
- [ ] `refactor:` / `test:` / `chore:` internal, no behavior change

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes locally
- [ ] Manually verified against a real Apps Script deployment (say what you tested, not just that you ran `npm test`)
- [ ] Added or updated a `CHANGELOG.md` entry under `## [Unreleased]`
- [ ] This change is generally useful to any adopting organization, not specific to one (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`)
